name: Wave Director
description: Runs enemy waves on a Multiplayer Server scene. The server owns the wave seed, the hit validators and the enemy health ledger; every player's game reconstructs the same spawns from the waves table in Game Config, so a wave costs no network traffic.

changelog.notes: Initial release: seeded wave plan reconstructed identically on every client, server-side health ledger and rate-limited hit/bite validators, wave counts read from the Game Config waves table
